description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Riptide Pilferer, adding {U}.
When Riptide Pilferer dies, Yedora triggers, returning Riptide Pilferer from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Riptide Pilferer by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Riptide Pilferer's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
